We have it built into the contingency. She [Vel Sartha] doesn't want to jeopardize the mission. This kid, I mean, this kid is the reason that we are here. He's alive.''"
"''How do we get to the doctor?|Arvel Skeen and Cassian Andor, on saving Karis Nemik|}} '''Frezno''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[moon]] with makeshift encampments for villages. [[Doctor]] [[Quadpaw]] operated in a [[tent]] on the moon, and was the activated contingency plan for a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel infiltration team]] that did a [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on the nearby [[planet]] [[Aldhani]] in [[5 BBY]]. Quadpaw attempted to save the injured rebel team member [[Karis Nemik]], but was [[Death|unsuccessful]] in his efforts. Meanwhile, another member of the team, [[Arvel Skeen]], tried to convince his teammate [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]] to flee with the team's [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]], but Andor shot him. Afterward, the rebel held Quadpaw and his team leader [[Vel Sartha]] at gunpoint, explaining the situation before leaving Frezno with his arranged cut from the heist. ==Description== [[File:Aldhani-Frezno-CLNE.png|thumb|right|300px|Frezno was located in the Outer Rim near Aldhani]] Frezno was a terrestrial [[moon]] located in the [[Frezno system]] within an intersecting portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories]] and the [[New Territories]] regions. Situated in the forgotten [[Cademimu sector]] at the coordinates M-6 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]], it [[orbit]]ed a [[planet]] that dominated the moon's sky. With a Type I [[atmosphere]] that was breathable to [[human]]s and other [[species]], Frezno featured tall and foggy grasslands. ==History== {{Quote|I'm taking my cut. The number I was promised. I'm leaving you the freighter and what's inside. I did my job. I'm done. And I wouldn't stick around if I was you.|Cassian Andor, to Vel Sartha|}} [[File:QuadpawOperates.png|thumb|left|300px|Quadpaw tries to save Karis Nemik]] During the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Jillsarian]] [[Doctor]] [[Quadpaw]] ran surgery in a [[tent]] on Frezno, tending to desperate patients with nowhere else to go and [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] to pay. He{{Databank|doctor-quadpaw|Doctor Quadpaw}} was in contact with a [[Aldhani rebel infiltration team|rebel infiltration team]] that had him as a contingency plan in their planned [[Aldhani heist|heist]] on the nearby{{Databank|frezno|Frezno}} planet [[Aldhani]]''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' in [[5 BBY]].{{AndorDate|106}} While the heist was a success, the contingency indeed came into play when one of the rebels in the team, [[Karis Nemik]], became seriously injured, and his teammate [[Arvel Skeen]] convinced the other survivors to take him to the Quadpaw. The rebel team arrived on Frezno in a stolen [[Max-7 Rono box freighter]] carrying the spoils of their heist: an Imperial payroll of around eighty million credits. In his operating theatre, Quadpaw began operating on the injured rebel, assisted by the team leader [[Vel Sartha]]. Meanwhile, the other two rebels, Skeen and [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], sat outside, speaking about whether Nemik would make it. Skeen quickly pivoted into offering Andor a chance to flee with the credits alongside him to an [[Unidentified moon (Arvel Skeen)|uninhabited moon]] that was eight [[parsec]]s away. The pair discussed each other's intentions, but as Skeen continued to detail his plan, Andor [[Death|fatally]] shot him. [[File:QuadpawBlasterpoint.png|thumb|right|300px|Cassian Andor holes Quadpaw and Vel Sartha at blasterpoint]] Meanwhile, Quadpaw was unable to save Nemik, who passed away on the operating table. As the surgery concluded, Andor entered the operating theatre with his [[Clem's blaster pistol|blaster]] drawn. Andor explained what had happened with Skeen, which Sartha struggled to believe. He then announced that he was leaving with his arranged cut of the stolen credits and Quadpaw's [[starship]], which he offered twice the value of for. Before Andor left, Sartha made him take [[The Trail of Political Consciousness|Nemik's manifesto]] with him, a request of their deceased teammate. Thus, both Andor and Sartha departed Frezno separately.{{Andor|Announcement}} ==Locations== {{Quote|I'll give you 30,000 credits for the ship in the barn. That's twice what it's worth.''"
"''Excuse me?|Andor and Quadpaw|audio=Andor-Quadpaw.flac|}} A hard-scrabble place, Frezno's villages were made up of makeshift encampments. Quadpaw operated in a dimly lit tent and kept a ship in a nearby barn. ==Behind the scenes== Frezno first appeared in "[[The Eye]]," the sixth episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]] of the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']]. The episode was released on [[October 22]], [[2022]].{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}} Scenes on the moon were first teased in the official trailer for the season, which was published on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' YouTube on [[August 1]] of that year.{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} Frezno was photographed in the hamlet of [[Wikipedia:Beedon|Beedon Common]] in the [[Wikipedia:England|English]] county of [[Wikipedia:Berkshire|Berkshire]].{{SW|url=andor-s1-e6-trivia-gallery|text="The Eye" Trivia Gallery | Andor}} {{C|Slide 4}} While the episode and its audio description establish that Frezno is a moon orbiting a planet,{{Andor|The Eye}} {{AD|Disney+}} the location's databank, as well as Quadpaw's, calls it a planet, along with [[Paddy Kempshall]]'s [[2023]] activity book ''[[The Ultimate Star Wars Quiz Book]]''''[[The Ultimate Star Wars Quiz Book]]'' and the [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''.
